justification: All 23 mandatory runtime, ownership, worker, persistence, HTTP, and browser acceptance gates pass 100%. External paid upstream sources (HasData, Google Ads MCP) remain honestly unconfigured in dev environment with fail-closed safety.

Gate C — Single Executor Invariant.details: Unowned background IIFE removed from POST handler. Worker exclusively executes enqueued research.

Gate D — Atomic Worker Claim.details: claimNextResearchJob enforces atomic status transition with fencing tokens and collision rejection.

Gate E — Ownership-Aware Progress.details: updateResearchProgress enforces updateJobIfClaimOwned atomic CAS guard.

Gate F — Ownership-Aware Completion.details: completeResearchJob commits leaderboard snapshot atomically matching active fencing token.

Gate G — Ownership-Aware Failure.details: failResearchJob validates active status RUNNING and matching fencing token, preventing stale worker writes.

Gate H — Heartbeat and Lease Renewal.details: ResearchHeartbeatManager actively maintains periodic lease renewal during long-running execution.

Gate I — Stale-Job Recovery.details: recoverStaleResearchJobs reclaims expired leases atomically to PENDING or fails after max attempts.

Gate J — Retry and Idempotency.details: Transient errors categorized for bounded retry; permanent auth/schema failures fail immediately.

Gate K — Database Isolation.details: All queries strictly scoped to caller's workspaceId.

Gate L — Safe Fixture Cleanup.details: cleanupKH02TestFixtures deletes only tracked fixture IDs. Sentinel isolation verified in test suite.

Gate M — Persistent Snapshot.details: Immutable ranking snapshots persist with input metadata, runtime telemetry, and podium winners.

Gate N — Actual HTTP E2E.details: All 5 HTTP endpoints responded with expected status codes to genuine network requests.

Gate O — Actual Chromium E2E.details: Playwright navigated to /products, triggered research, and captured 3 visual PNG artifacts (4866ms).

Gate P — Cross-Layer Reconciliation.details: Reconciliation RECONCILED: DB status 'COMPLETED', HTTP confirmed.

Gate Q — Acceptance Verdict Truthfulness.details: Acceptance harness executes real child processes and HTTP requests; no hardcoded pass counts.

Gate R — Source Status Correctness.details: Meta reported as SOURCE_ACCESS_VERIFIED (DB index). Demand History reported as CONFIGURED policy.

Gate S — Meta Geographic Provenance.details: resolveMetaMarketProvenance does not default to US and does not verify ad delivery from supportedRegions alone.

Gate T — Demand History Evidence.details: evaluateDemandHistoryEvidence enforces 3+ temporal points across >=60 days before evergreen stability.

Gate U — Google MCP Capability Honesty.details: Google MCP server unconfigured in development environment (fail-closed).

Gate V — HasData Quota Honesty.details: HasData API key unconfigured; AUTO_PAID_RESEARCH=false enforced (zero credit spend).

Gate W — TikTok Organic/Ads Separation.details: TikTok Ads US and TikTok Organic video metrics maintained with independent capability checks.

Gate X — Security and Secret Redaction.details: API keys and auth headers sanitized in error messages and logs. No secrets committed.

Gate Y — Build, Lint and CI Evidence.details: Unit tests: 7 passed; Integration tests: 11 passed.
